title: Glowing cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='cocoa' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B5A2B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5C3317'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD98A' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD98A' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M38 30 Q34 22 40 16 Q46 10 42 2' fill='none' stroke='#FFE8B0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M50 28 Q54 18 48 12 Q42 6 48 0' fill='none' stroke='#FFE8B0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M62 30 Q66 22 60 16 Q54 10 60 2' fill='none' stroke='#FFE8B0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- glow behind cup -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#E8E8F0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#C8C8DA'/>

  <!-- cup body -->
  <path d='M28 48 L32 82 Q33 86 50 86 Q67 86 68 82 L72 48 Z' fill='#F5F5FA'/>
  <path d='M28 48 L32 82 Q33 86 50 86 Q67 86 68 82 L72 48 Z' fill='none' stroke='#D6D6E4' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- cup highlight -->
  <path d='M33 52 L36 78 Q37 81 42 81' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M72 56 Q86 56 86 68 Q86 80 71 80' fill='none' stroke='#F5F5FA' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 56 Q86 56 86 68 Q86 80 71 80' fill='none' stroke='#D6D6E4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' transform='translate(0,-3)' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='6' fill='url(#cocoa)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#FFB84D' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- marshmallows -->
  <rect x='40' y='44' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <rect x='52' y='45' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFF0F5'/>
  <rect x='46' y='46' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#FFF8F0'/>

  <!-- cocoa swirl -->
  <path d='M44 49 Q50 47 56 49' fill='none' stroke='#C8854A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- warm glow rim on cocoa -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='17' ry='3.5' fill='#FFD98A' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
